title: SB 319 (2023-2024 (135th General Assembly)): S. B. No. 319: Require proof of citizenship to register to vote
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(1) (reprinted unchanged)
(quote) When an elector appears in a polling place to vote, the elector shall announce to the precinct election officials the elector's full name and current address and provide photo identification.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(2)
(quote) If an elector does not have or is unable to provide photo identification to the precinct election officials, or if the pollbook indicates that the elector is a federal-only voter, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code. (the words 'or if the pollbook indicates that the elector is a federal-only voter,' are new)
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) R.C. 3503.01(A)(2)
(quote) An elector who registers to vote or submits a change of residence or change of name form on or after the effective date of this amendment shall provide proof of citizenship to the board of elections. An elector whose registration record indicates that the elector has provided proof of citizenship to a board of elections is not required to provide proof of citizenship when subsequently registering to vote or updating the elector's registration in this state.
(section) R.C. 3501.01(EE)(1)
(quote) "Proof of citizenship" means evidence that an individual is a United States citizen, in the form of one of the following: (a) The number of the individual's current or expired Ohio driver's license or state identification card, if the board of elections verifies using information obtained from the bureau of motor vehicles that the individual has submitted documentation to the bureau that indicates that the individual is a United States citizen; (b) The individual's current or expired Ohio driver's license, state identification card, or interim identification form issued on or after April 7, 2023, or a copy of the front and back of that license, card, or form, if the license, card, or form does not include a notation designating that the individual is a noncitizen of the United States; (c) The individual's current or expired driver's license or nondriver identification card issued by another state within the United States, or a copy of the front and back of the license or card, if the issuing agency indicates on the license or card that the individual is a United States citizen; (d) The individual's birth certificate, certification of report of birth, or consular report of birth abroad, or a copy of one of those documents; (e) The individual's current or expired United States passport or passport card, a copy of the identification page of the passport, or a copy of the front and back of the passport card; (f) The individual's certificate of naturalization or certificate of citizenship or a copy of one of those documents.
(section) R.C. 3503.01(A)(3)
(quote) An elector who registers to vote or updates the elector's registration on a form prescribed under 52 U.S.C. 20301, 20303, or 20508 and does not provide proof of citizenship as required under division (A)(2)(a) of this section is a federal-only voter unless the elector provides proof of citizenship to the board in accordance with division (F)(1) of section 3503.201 of the Revised Code. A federal-only voter may vote in any federal election held in the precinct in which the elector resides but is not eligible to vote in any other election and is not eligible to sign an election petition.
(section) R.C. 3503.201(F)(1)
(quote) A federal-only voter becomes eligible to vote on the state and local candidates, questions, and issues appearing on the ballot at an election if the federal-only voter does one of the following: (a) Submits proof of citizenship to the board of elections, in person or by mail, not later than the thirtieth day before the day of the election; (b) Casts absent voter's ballots by mail and submits proof of citizenship to the board of elections along with the elector's voted absent voter's ballots or not later than the fourth day after the day of the election; (c) Casts a provisional ballot and submits proof of citizenship to the board of elections along with the elector's provisional ballot or not later than the fourth day after the day of the election.
(section) R.C. 3503.201(A)
(quote) When the board of elections receives a voter registration application or a notice of change of address or change of name, the board shall attempt to verify the applicant's United States citizenship by doing one of the following: (1) Confirming that the applicant has provided proof of citizenship and noting that fact in the applicant's voter registration record. ... (2) Determining that the applicant's existing voter registration record obtained from the statewide voter registration database indicates that a board of elections has previously verified the applicant as a United States citizen.
(e_other_rule)
(section) R.C. 3503.14(A)(5)
(quote) One of the following forms of identification and proof of citizenship: (a) The applicant's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number, which the board of elections shall use to verify that the individual has submitted documentation to the bureau of motor vehicles that indicates that the individual is a United States citizen; (b) The last four digits of the applicant's social security number and proof of citizenship.
(section) R.C. 3503.16(B)(1)(a)
(quote) STRUCK: Any registered elector who moves within a precinct on or prior to the day of a general, primary, or special election and has not filed a notice of change of residence with the board of elections may vote in that election by going to that registered elector's assigned polling place, completing and signing a notice of change of residence, showing photo identification, and casting a ballot.
(section) R.C. 3503.201 (poll notice)
(quote) Voters must bring photo identification to the polls in order to verify identity. Voters who do not provide photo identification will still be able to vote by casting a provisional ballot.
(other) 3503.06, 3503.13, 3503.15: registration records note proof of citizenship and verification date
(other) 3503.151-3503.153: data-matching reports; flagged people must provide proof of citizenship or cancel registration
(other) 3503.16, 3503.19, 3503.21: mover and name-change rules, notices, cancellation
(other) 3503.201 (new): registration verification process, 20-business-day registration deadline, federal-only voter status
(other) 3505.181-3505.183: provisional ballots for federal-only voters count only for federal races unless proof of citizenship is given within four days
(other) 3505.182: provisional ballot envelope text on proof of citizenship
(other) 3505.20, 3509.04-3509.08, 3511.xx: challenge and absentee/military-overseas handling conformed
(other) note: Documentary proof of citizenship is required of every new registrant or updater (proof includes a licence number the BMV can match to citizenship papers). Anyone using a federal form without proof is a 'federal-only voter'. Photo ID at polls is existing law reprinted; mail ballot ID text not changed in marked words. Sole version. The cross-reference in 3503.01(A)(3) to '(A)(2)(a)' points to a division that does not exist in the saved text.
